definition.en: Cooking ingredients quickly in a small amount of hot oil or butter over medium-high heat while stirring frequently.
definition.te: తక్కువ నూనె లేదా వెన్నలో కూరగాయలను దోరగా వేయించే పద్ధతి.

examples: Sautéing bell peppers for fried rice

definition.en: Cooking liquid gently just below boiling point with small, gentle bubbles breaking softly at the surface.
definition.te: మరుగు స్థాయికి కొంచెం తక్కువగా సన్నని మంటపై నెమ్మదిగా ఉడికించే పద్ధతి.

definition.en: Frying whole spices and aromatics (like mustard seeds, cumin, garlic, and curry leaves) in hot ghee or oil to extract essential oils, then pouring over the dish.
definition.te: నూనె లేదా నెయ్యిలో ఆవాలు, జీలకర్ర, ఎండుమిర్చి, కరివేపాకు వేయించి వంటకానికి సువాసన చేకూర్చే ముఖ్యమైన ప్రక్రియ.

examples: Tadka for Sambar, Dal, or Coconut Chutney

definition.en: Slow-cooking meats, rice, or vegetables in a sealed heavy pot over gentle heat so ingredients cook entirely in their own trapped aromatic steam.
definition.te: ఆవిరి బయటకు పోకుండా మూతను గట్టిగా మూసి సన్నని సెగపై నెమ్మదిగా వండే పురాతన రాజరిక పద్ధతి.

definition.en: Working dough with the heels of your hands to develop gluten structure for soft chapatis, rotis, or bread.
definition.te: చేతి మడమలతో పిండిని అదిమి మృదువుగా అయ్యేలా ఒత్తే విధానం.

examples: Kneading wheat flour dough for soft rotis

definition.en: Beating ingredients rapidly using a wire whisk or fork to incorporate air and blend smoothly without lumps.
definition.te: పెరుగు, గుడ్లు లేదా పిండి మిశ్రమాలను ఉండలు లేకుండా ఒకే దిశలో వేగంగా కలపడం.

examples: Whisking curd for raita or lassi

equipment.name: Cast Iron Tawa / Griddle
equipment.desc: Maintains uniform high heat retention for paper-crisp dosas and authentic scorched rotis.

equipment.name: Heavy-Bottom Kadai / Wok
equipment.desc: Prevents gravies, milk, and spices from scorching during prolonged sautéing and deep frying.

equipment.name: Pressure Cooker / Instant Pot
equipment.desc: Tenderizes tough lentils like toor dal and chickpeas in a fraction of standard boiling time.

equipment.name: High-Torque Wet & Dry Blender
equipment.desc: Essential for reducing tomatoes, soaked cashews, and coconuts into silky smooth restaurant purees.

equipment.name: Pappu Gutti (Wooden Dal Masher)
equipment.desc: Mashes boiled lentils and stewed greens softly without destroying natural texture like electric blades do.

safety.title: Tadka (Tempering) Splatter Prevention
safety.desc: Ensure curry leaves and green chillies are wiped dry with a clean kitchen towel before adding them to hot oil or ghee.

safety.title: Blending Hot Liquids Safely
safety.desc: Never fill a blender jar to the top with steaming gravies. Steam expansion can pop the lid violently. Let the mixture cool 5 minutes, fill half, and hold the lid with a folded cloth.

safety.title: Deep Frying Temperature Control
safety.desc: Use a deep, stable pan with flat bottom. Gently slide fritters or gulab jamuns from the side of the pan rather than dropping from height.

safety.title: Raw Dairy & Protein Hygiene
safety.desc: Store paneer immersed in salted water in the refrigerator, and consume within 3-4 days. Always sanitize cutting boards after prepping perishables.

mistakes.cause: Adding paste directly into super-hot empty oil.
mistakes.fix: Always sauté onions first. Once onions release moisture and turn translucent, add ginger-garlic paste and sauté on medium heat for 60 seconds.

mistakes.cause: Frying paneer cubes on high heat for too long.
mistakes.fix: Add fresh paneer cubes directly into hot simmering gravy during the last 3-4 minutes of cooking, or soak in warm salted water for 5 minutes.
Cook basmati rice in rolling boiling water only up to 70% (grain breaks into 3 parts when pinched). It finishes cooking in trapped dum steam.
